title: Smoofy's Books
description: An enchanted book resource pack. Each book tries to illustrate what the enchantment does.
body:
![An off-yellow scroll containing the central text "Smoofy's Books" with adjacent images of books, an anvil, and an enchanting table, all in front of a bookshelf background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/348aac0cb8abce11a94fb60f4861ea1eae3923b0.png)
## What is Smoofy's Books?

**It's a resource pack which changes all enchanted book textures to be more clear in their function.**

• Each book gets it's own designated color for the type of equipment it can be applied to.

![an image with 9 colored segments, each containing a differently colored enchanted book and white text to describe the book's individual function.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88e6f9c23e1f11078c3ba1db6dd31defadb95a8d.png)

• Most books get a resource-themed indicator for their level.

![an image with 5 differently colored segments, each containing a differently leveled enchanted book and black text to describe each book's individual level.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9a48d0eebf5cc4ad4a6bee63c47e06fede48658.png)

• Some books also layer textures when combined in an anvil.

![a mending book and an unbreaking 3 book being combined in an anvil to create a book with both of their textures combined.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba4112c4593bc020c2a2cf923b1ad9e5f9c1e5c8.png)

## But why?
• Sorting chests takes less than 2-3 millennia.

• You can immediately tell what enchantment a librarian villager is selling. 

• It helps immensely when looking through chests in a dungeon, mineshaft, library, etc.

• What's the difference between impaling IV and piercing IV? The book knows.


## Any Dependencies?
**Nope**. Just play at or above 1.21.5, put it in the resource pack folder, and play!



Feel free to use the pack for personal use, in a modpack, in a youtube video, or on twitch.

You can't do anything else with the pack unless you ask Smoofy98 on discord though.
